text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before training, Loves Only You
was hosting a livestream.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: And now for our popular segment! The 'Let's Read Fan Letters' session is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Today, I'll be reading letters from people who asked, 'Please read this out loud!'"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Every time I watch Loves-chan in action, I'm reminded of the importance of hard work."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do my best at the upcoming marathon too.
I really want to share good news with Loves-chan...!"

text_block_list.name: Letter Sender A
text_block_list.text: "Whoa!? They actually read mine out loud!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, do your best in the marathon!
I'll be eagerly waiting for the results!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Now then, the next letter is......

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Make sure to rest your body well, too.
A healthy, energetic Loves-chan is the best!"

text_block_list.name: Letter Sender B
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! That's my fan letter!!
Loves-chaaan! Don't overdo it, okay?!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Getting to interact
with everyone like this is so soothing♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's love reached me loud and clear!
Right now, it's really touching my heart...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've gotta head off to training soon!
So that's all for today's stream!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She asked with a serious expression.
The stopwatch in her hand showed a new personal best time.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yay! I knew that felt good!
choice_data_list: You were especially fired up today
You were especially fired up today, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Because I received so much love from the fan letters!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta return all the love everyone gave me
with the absolute best kind of love!
